provenance.interpretation_note: Rule-based unsupported-content flags are conservative automated diagnostics, not a clinically validated hallucination metric.

dataset_and_split.extent_definition: training-set tertiles of whole-tumour voxel count
dataset_and_split.hemisphere_definition: dominant tumour volume in canonical RAS world-x coordinates; case-specific midline from nonzero FLAIR brain bounds; midline-plane voxels reported separately; exact side ties flagged ambiguous

project.name: Reliable and Grounded Vision-Language Analysis for Structured Brain Tumor MRI Report Generation
Reliable and Grounded Vision-Language Analysis for Structured Brain Tumor MRI Report Generation
Reliable and Grounded Vision-Language Analysis for Structured Brain Tumor MRI Report Generation

vlm.conditioning: frozen slot-CNN predictions from FLAIR MRI for train/validation/test consistency
vlm.training_target: explicit five-slot anchor plus at most one patient-independent generic MRI signal descriptor
vlm.rag_training_context: patient-independent style cues only; mixed base/RAG prompt exposure; self-retrieval excluded
vlm.prompt_supervision: visual tokens and all prompt/RAG tokens masked with -100; only assistant report target supervised

rag.context_type: patient-independent style cues only + structured slot signature

segmentation.evaluation_space: prediction nearest-neighbour mapped to canonical original BraTS grid; metrics against original held-out mask
segmentation.hd95_definition: MONAI symmetric 95th-percentile Hausdorff distance using original canonical NIfTI physical voxel spacing; units=mm

vlm_metrics.structure_metric_note: Raw-generation metrics measure the language-model text before slot-grounding/structural repair; final-pipeline metrics measure the delivered report after the explicit deployment-available slot guardrail.
